topPRs.title: feat: zk dispute game
topPRs.author: ashitakah
topPRs.body:
The spec for the smart contract side of the ZK dispute game integration into the OP Stack.                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                          
Four spec files are added covering the `ZKDisputeGame` contract: the overall design and OPCM integration, the full game lifecycle and bond accounting, the `IZKVerifier` interface, and the ZK program definition (inputs, outputs, `absolutePrestate`).

The game resolves disputes in a single round - a proposer posts an output root, anyone can challenge it, and a prover submits a ZK proof to defend the claim or lets the window expire. It follows the same patterns as `FaultDisputeGame` (MCP clones, `DelayedWETH`, permissionless access, same safety checks) while adding verifier agnosticism through `IZKVerifier`, parent chaining, and SP1 PLONK as the initial proving backend.
